evals.prompt: I need a poster for a members-only cocktail night at a hotel bar. Give me the style direction for the image prompt.
evals.expected_output: Picks style:art-deco (optionally with one second style) with a reason tied to the event; Runs design_styles.py show art-deco and looks at the saved board image; Returns a style block that starts with 'Art Deco' and lists concrete cues (gold hairline geometry, deep navy or black, tall geometric sans, centred hero object, foil sheen); Lists an avoid line that forbids copying the board posters; Hands off to ai-image
assertions: Names a vocabulary style tag such as style:art-deco rather than only mood words like elegant or premium
Runs skills/design-styles/scripts/design_styles.py show for the chosen style and views the board image
The style block leads with the style name and gives at least four concrete visual cues
States that the board posters are not copied or used as image references
Names ai-image as the next owner

evals.prompt: What style is this reference? It's a workshop poster: lilac and lime cards with thick black outlines, hard black drop shadows with no blur, pill-shaped buttons, a couple of pink starbursts, chunky sans headline on a light grid-paper background. I want our agent-office demo day poster in the same style.
evals.expected_output: Names style:neo-brutalism from the vocabulary (not plain Brutalism, not Memphis) and says what in the reference sets it apart; Runs design_styles.py show neo-brutalism and views the board; Returns a style block led by 'Neo-Brutalism' with outline weight, unblurred offset shadow, flat fills, pill buttons and type; Keeps orange out; Does not copy the described poster layout or text; Hands off to ai-image
assertions: Names style:neo-brutalism and distinguishes it from Brutalism or Memphis
The style block names hard black outlines and unblurred offset shadows as concrete cues
Names ai-image as the next owner

evals.prompt: Make the landing page hero for our desert retreat feel warm, rugged and a bit mystical. Western vibes, sunset colours. What style should the hero image use?
evals.expected_output: Maps the brief to style:mystical-western and/or style:wild-west from the vocabulary; Pulls the recipe and board with show; Swaps the genre's orange, terracotta and sunset-orange for sage, saddle brown, dusty teal, gold or bone and says so in the avoid list; Gives at most two styles, one for structure and one for surface; Returns a style block that leads with the style name
assertions: Picks style:mystical-western or style:wild-west from the vocabulary
